primitives.name: Stadium Weather Forecast Provider
primitives.verbatim_quote: A weather provider: given (stadium, game datetime), return the kickoff-window forecast — temperature, wind speed/gusts, precipitation probability and amount, humidity — plus derived flags (wind >15mph, heavy rain, extreme cold <20°F, extreme heat >95°F, dome/roof = weather irrelevant).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T': 'temperature in °F', 'W': 'wind speed in mph', 'P': 'precipitation probability in %', 'R': 'rainfall amount in inches', 'H': 'humidity in %', 'D': 'dome flag (0 or 1)'}
primitives.assumptions: Atmospheric conditions are stationary over kickoff window; spatial interpolation valid for stadium location.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When D=1, all weather variables are set to neutral values; W>15mph triggers penalty multiplier.

layer2.mapping: Maps environmental state to NFL performance modifiers via empirical regression coefficients.
layer2.telemetry: Forecast accuracy vs actual game-day metrics (passing yards, field goal success rate)

primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Mission 2: Sketch the GSE agent skill **Why:** Vaisala just shipped their weather API as provider-neutral agent skills (agentskills.io standard, Linux Foundation) so every coding agent can build on it without reading docs.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S': 'skill vector in R^n', 'A': 'agent interface object', 'P': 'projection function'}
primitives.assumptions: Agent skills are composable and standardized across platforms; no proprietary dependencies.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When API unavailable, fallback to static skill profile with default weights.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic mapping between skill specification and agent execution context.
layer2.telemetry: Skill invocation frequency and successful integration into assistant workflows
